quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Chemical semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-10-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April-September 2025): sales revenue JPY 1,095,394 million against JPY 1,241,395 million (down JPY 146.0 billion), on PetroRabigh's scheduled maintenance, aluminum restructuring and lower shipments of TV polarizing film and color resist; core operating income JPY 108.7 billion against JPY 29.5 billion; operating income JPY 103.7 billion against JPY 121.2 billion; net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 39.7 billion against a loss in the prior-year period. H1 R&D expenses JPY 67.0 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 sales revenue JPY 1,095,394 million (prior JPY 1,241,395 million); core operating income JPY 108.7 billion (prior JPY 29.5 billion)

quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Chemical semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-10-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: ICT & Mobility Solutions H1: sales revenue JPY 283.5 billion, down JPY 24.0 billion; core operating income JPY 33.1 billion, down JPY 10.5 billion. Management states shipments of display-related materials and of the semiconductor process materials high-purity chemicals and photoresists all decreased because of inventory adjustments in the market and shifts in demand timing; a stronger yen reduced export proceeds and the yen value of overseas subsidiaries, and the drastic restructuring of the large LCD polarizing film business also weighed.
quarterly_data.figure: ICT & Mobility Solutions H1 sales revenue JPY 283.5 billion (down JPY 24.0 billion); core operating income JPY 33.1 billion (down JPY 10.5 billion)

quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Chemical semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-10-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Other segments H1: Agro & Life Solutions sales revenue JPY 213.0 billion, core operating income JPY 11.2 billion (crop protection shipments firm in India and elsewhere but South American market prices fell; methionine prices and volumes down); Essential & Green Materials sales revenue JPY 329.1 billion, down JPY 121.8 billion, core operating loss JPY 18.6 billion, improved by JPY 16.1 billion on better terms of trade at PetroRabigh and in synthetic resins; Sumitomo Pharma sales revenue JPY 226.1 billion, up JPY 45.7 billion, core operating income JPY 97.3 billion, up JPY 94.3 billion (ORGOVYX and GEMTESA growth in North America, an ORGOVYX sales milestone, a gain on the partial transfer of the Asia business); Advanced Medical Solutions sales revenue JPY 21.1 billion with a core operating loss of JPY 1.4 billion, as API and intermediate shipments fell because some products shipped at a different time from the prior-year period.
quarterly_data.figure: Essential & Green Materials H1 core operating loss JPY 18.6 billion; Sumitomo Pharma H1 core operating income JPY 97.3 billion
